messages:
Priya Nair: opening thread for ticket #3510 — customer says they were billed for both an initial truncated stream and the resumed stream after a client retry. billing shows two provisional rows.
Daren Liu: do we have the router traces? sounds like a cross-route retry.
Mei Park: logs show client got EOF after 4 chunks, retried, and CDN routed retry to a different cluster. both clusters emitted provisional grants. no toolcalls in this request.
Priya Nair: customer used short prompt + streaming. billing rows have different route ids so support assumed two separate calls.
Ben (billing): provisional credits are recorded by the route that awarded them. we only finalize when confirm event arrives. cross-route retries will look like duplicates unless session_id is preserved.
Liz (console): we should make provisional vs confirmed clearer in ledger UI. can we add a provisional badge and route_id column so support sees origin?
Mei Park: agree. telemetry fix: emit stream.session.present header when client supplies it and include route_id on stream.segment.grant events.
Daren Liu: SDKs should recommend a client_session_id header for streaming. if client doesn't send it, server-generated id won't survive CDN retries.
Ben (billing): for refunds we need high-confidence dedupe heuristics. suggest grouping provisional rows by (customer_id + client_session_id) when present; otherwise flag for manual review.
Priya Nair: what about prompt-hash heuristics? could we collapse if prompt_prefix(24) + first_confirmed_token match within 30s?
Ben (billing): risky. shorter prompts collide. if we auto-merge we need an audit trail and legal signoff. otherwise mark as "potential duplicate" in UI.
Liz (console): I'll add a filter that surfaces "potential duplicate provisional charges" using the heuristics Ben suggested and show raw telemetry links. ETA 48hrs for a quick filter.
Mei Park: longer-term RFC idea: billing reconciliation step that collapses provisional grants only when one side confirms and the others are within a time window and share session id or a high-entropy fingerprint. include never-merge if any entry contains toolcall.invocation.
Daren Liu: callout: toolcalls complicate de-dupe because they can cause external side effects. require toolcall idempotency token before merging.
Priya Nair: ops-bot: add reconciliation RFC review to weekly oncall agenda.
ops-bot: task created: RFC-review queued for next oncall meeting.
Priya Nair: I'll reply to customer with interim note: provisional grants can appear per-route and we are adding UI flags + telemetry to help reconcile. will follow up after RFC.
